subject: Two issues with iframes using navbarPage

messages.author: 2dc50513792871a4
messages.subject: Two issues with iframes using navbarPage
parts:
Hi,

I am making an app using the navbarPage layout (shiny devel version 0.8.0.99). The app is very simple, just a social media/content aggregator, where the navbar menus represent my website, blog, previous shiny apps I've made, etc. I use iframes to embed the content in the app. However, there are two issues. And perhaps I would have the same issues in another shiny version, and even if not using navbarPage. I don't think it necessarily has to do with navbarPage; that just happens to be what I am using.

1. The iframes I use to embed shiny apps appear to load the initial ui.R in the browser, but no plots will appear and the app is not responsive when I click on fields in the iframe. I can "click" things, but there is no reactivity. If I am very quick to click on a navbar menu to display an iframe-embedded shiny app as soon as this app loads, then the app inside the iframe will run, plots will plot, it's responsive, and reactivity is present. The iframe-embedded app inside this app runs fine. But for some reason if I just let my app load for a second, and then casually visit the page via the navbar where another app is shown in an iframe, somehow it's "too late" and any embedded apps do not work.

2. The second issue is somewhat ironic in comparison to the first. If I can find a way to make my apps in iframes responsive and reactive, I then also have to find away to get them to NOT all load inside their iframes when I first launch my app. There are way too many! (Many more than shown below.) I would like to prevent the content from loading while it is hidden at app launch, and only load the content in an iframe once it is made visible by clicking on the appropriate navbar menu option. The only ways I know of to do things like this are with action buttons and isolate(). Is there some kind of way I can combine isolate() perhaps with tabPanel IDs to prevent loading lots of hidden iframes when I load the app?

Here is some example navbarPage code that I experience these two issues with:

navbarPage("Matt Leonawicz",
tabPanel("Website", fluidRow( column(12, "", mainPanel(tags$iframe(src="http://statmatt.com/", width="1150", height="925"))) ), id="website"),
tabPanel("Blog", fluidRow( column(12, "", mainPanel(tags$iframe(src="http://blog.snap.uaf.edu/", width="1150", height="925"))) ), id="snapblog"),
navbarMenu("Other Apps",
tabPanel("Sea ice & winds", fluidRow( column(12, "", mainPanel(tags$iframe(src="http://shiny.snap.uaf.edu/sea_ice_winds/", width="1150", height="925"))) ), id="app_ice_winds"),
tabPanel("Sea ice coverage", fluidRow( column(12, "", mainPanel(tags$iframe(src="http://shiny.snap.uaf.edu/sea_ice_coverage/", width="1150", height="925"))) ), id="app_ice_cov"),
tabPanel("Temperature & winds", fluidRow( column(12, "", mainPanel(tags$iframe(src="http://shiny.snap.uaf.edu/temp_wind_events/", width="1150", height="925"))) ), id="app_temp_wind")
)
)

Thanks,
Matt
